caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a woven seat. The chair features three horizontal, curved back slats between two vertical posts that extend above the slats and are topped with finials. The chair's legs and supports are cylindrical and turned, displaying various ornamental shapes. There are three stretchers on each side and two on the back, all round and turned, providing structure and support. The seat is made of a light brown woven material, contrasting with the warm reddish-brown tone of the wood. The background is plain and beige, with light shading cast beneath the chair, and there is a faint signature in the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
